introduction.title: A short introduction
introduction.summary: I have spent years around vintage record players and still get a real kick out of bringing a tired machine back into everyday use. My aim is simple: be honest about what is worth doing, take care over the details, and help people keep these wonderful players going.

about.title: A workshop built around practical restoration, careful servicing and honest advice.
paragraphs: Every machine is assessed on its own condition, not pushed into a one-size-fits-all package. Some need a simple service, some need mechanical overhaul, and some deserve a full cosmetic and electrical restoration.

The workshop is still in its setup phase, so not every detail on the site is fixed yet. Even so, serious enquiries are welcome and we will be upfront about what we can fit in, what needs more time, and what is worth doing.
about.imageAlt: A restored vintage Dansette record player with fresh cabinet covering
